W-what a relief...
Are you guys okay?
Grab your weapon
Extend a hand
W-wait!\nI'm free from Coenubia now.\nPlease keep your weapon!
It's okay.\nShe's no longer possessed by Coenubia.
Reliza, are you okay now?
Yes, I'm sorry for the trouble I've caused...
I was worried because she had been sleeping all\nthe time on the ark since she the Coenubia left\nher body. But I think she's fine now.
I'm glad to hear that...I was worried about you.
You guys are lucky. I've kinda fixed the ark, so I\njust came out and I was about to do a test flight\nto see how it is.
Then when I looked up, I saw you guys falling\nfrom the sky. I was surprised...
Um? Judging from your appearance...\nAre you by any chance a weredragon?
Huh? Y-yeah, I'm Zianga. Nice to meet you.
I'm Kunon. The president of Mithurna and the\nGoddess of Justice...
Um, it looks like the ark isn't completely\nrepaired yet.
What?!
Let's return to Erva Tronc while it's still\nflying!\nHold on tight!!
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing. Let's return to Erva Tronc!
Explore Propulsion System Zone more!
Whoo, it's become much more comfortable.
Yeah, that's because after it's repaired, it can\navoid and take advantage of the force fields...
Now I feel like I understand what Aunt Stormia\nmeant when she talked about feeling the wind to\nsteer the ark...
The rear-engine is fine, both ailerons are normal\nand stable, and all other parts were easily fixed.\nKunon, I think you've successfully landed the ark.
Really? Thanks, Zianga...
So, were Muti, Mare and Aga able to get home\nsafely?
Don't worry, Muti is being welcomed warmly by\nKinda because he has successfully got the Ranas to\nform an alliance with them against Coenubia.
Aye, how about Mare and Aga?
They're fine.\nThe council praised them for helping to form the\nalliance...
Oh, I almost forgot. Mare left you a message.\nThe mainland Rana resistance fighter went back to\npersuade his kingdom, right?
Oh, you're talking about Unda~.
If he manages to convince the kingdom, they'd make\na strong ally. Mare is worried about the outcome,\nso she wants you to look into it.
Mwahaha!
H-hey, what's with that disturbing laugh?
It's love, you know! Saying she was worried about\nthe outcome was just an excuse. She's actually\njust hoping Unda, her love, is safe~!
Aye~? What are you talking about~?
You think so? Anyway, you should really stay out\nof other people's love lives.
Well, it's important to find out what the outcome\nis, though. Wanna go check the shoreline and see\nif we can find any information there?
Well, okay, let's go have a quick look, shall we?\nWe can go to the Nebbia Coast from here.\nIt's close to Rana's territory.
The coast...I'd rather not expose the ark to the\nsea breeze, so I'll drop you off somewhere near\nthere and you do the rest on your own.
Oh, I just remembered! There's something I'd like\nto ask you, Kunon!
Ah, about Freedos, right?\nYou wanna ask whether he's a real god or not,\nright?
What?!\nDid you just say Freedos?
Aye? Kunon, you look so surprised!
You met Freedos, the God of Peace?!
Huh, wait...\nCould this reaction mean...
No way...Is that guy really a god?
That's because he values harmony more than\nanything, so I can understand if you find his\nwords and actions rather strange.
He might even allow Coenubia to grow if it means\nbringing peace to the world.
Now that you mention it, I think he said something\nlike that.
So, that guy, I mean, Freedos really has the royal\ndragon cocoon?
Freedos isn't the kind of god who needs to bluff\nto appear powerful.
Everyone knows how important he is. If we were to\nrank him, his position would probably be higher\nthan Vasaria's.
Hmm, it doesn't seem like that to me, though.
Whoa!! We almost attacked him the other day.\nThat was a bit too much, wasn't it?!
I'd like to hear Freedos' thoughts on the current\nsituation of Toram. I hope I can meet him soon...
Ugh, I need to get a gift for Freedos so he\ndoesn't think I was making a fool of him~!
Can I just give him money? What's a good gift for\nhim? Hehe! What if I just give him the rock that\nlooks like a Holy Gem I found on the road?!
...Are you trying to bribe a god? I think you're\nactually the one making the biggest fool of him.
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing. Let's go back!
Explore this place a little longer!
We're here. Nebbia Coast is right below us.\nEven from here, I can already see monsters roaming\naround. You have to be very careful.
Okay! What about you, Kunon? What are you gonna do\nnow?
This ark is too noticeable. It might attract\nbandits, so I'm gonna move it somewhere else and\nwait for you guys there.
It's gonna be a bit far from the sea.\nIf anything goes wrong, get back here right\naway...
Alright, we won't go too far.
Bye, Kunon!
Looks like the adventure ahead is gonna be tough\ntoo, will you be fine, Anono? Let's just focus on\nfinishing your language learning here...
A-aye! S-see you later!
I got it...You wanna check out that Fango Village\nyou heard about from the Rana prince, and you want\nme to take you there, right?
Exactly!\nSince we're all set, let's get moving!!
Hmm, someone's really pumped up today.
I have a feeling we'll find Anono's friends this\ntime for sure! After all, this kid needs to be\naround his own kind!
Yeah, around my own kind!
Right, there are times he acts a bit strange,\nespecially recently. So there might be things\nabout him that we just can't understand.
Alright! Worst case, we find nothing and it'll be\na wasted effort, but let's go check out that\nFango Village anyway!
I guess this is where the ride ends.\nThe towering mountains ahead are too dangerous for\nme to take you any further.
We definitely won't be able to land because of the\nturbulent air currents...
Really? Well, I guess it is what it is.\nWe just need to go straight from here, right?
Yeah, just go over the mountain range down there.\nI'm not sure if there's a trail...But you guys\nshould have no trouble making it through.
Tch, a god who resorts to sweet talk?\nThat's a new one.
So, what are you gonna do now, Kunon?
I've been picking up Freedos' presence for a\nwhile. I'll see if I can find him.
I don't wanna draw too much attention. I'll land\nthe ark on a flat plain and keep it out of sight.\nI'll start looking from there.
That's a good idea!\nBut please come pick us up if things go south!\nWe're really counting on you, you know!
Okay, I'll keep an eye on my surroundings.\nIf anything seems off, I'll come get you.
Aye! See you later, Kunon!
Anono!
Aye?
I really hope you find your friends...
Aye, aye!
